basis: Item 8 draft, 2026-10-29. A dark compact candidate with its own shadow: two_sided at or above 3.0 (q0.99 of dark_compact false alarms is 2.55, q0.999 3.87) and a shadow run reading as 0.5 to 3 m. Dust-covered hardware is dark but still stands above the ground and casts a shadow; a dark polygon trough does not. Kept beside the adopted saturation rule.

rules.name: dark_shadow
rules.basis: a dark object that still casts a shadow of the right length stands above the ground; a dark patch in the ground does not
